messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: dedpool node gpu-06 (valora-dedpool-3) entered BMC lock state after spot eviction. health checks failing, several ValoraAI tenants (primary: valora-prod) seeing inference errors 500/timeout. auto-fallback attempted but some sessions still failing. page severity: high. please ack and start mitigation.

sam-oncall-nyc: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs and isolating traffic. tagging valora custops: @lina-custops.

alex-sre: thx sam. can you put the node into maintenance/drain ASAP and move tenants to reserve pool? command: `redwood ctl node drain gpu-06 --pool dedpool-3 --reason "bmc-lock after spot"`

sam-oncall-nyc: running drain now.

```
$ redwood ctl node drain gpu-06 --pool dedpool-3 --reason "bmc-lock after spot"
INFO: scheduling migrate for 12 active tenants
INFO: live-sessions: 18, queued: 4
```

sam-oncall-nyc: drain issued — migration started, moving valora-prod to reserve-dedicated-1. routing rule applied: fallback-model-route -> reserve-dedicated-1.

jin-eng-runtime: good. I'll enable degraded-mode model variants for valora-prod to reduce KV/memory pressure: `model_variant=quant-8x@fallback` for the session window. Also enabling aggressive prefix cache to reduce token work.

maya-infra: I'm looking at the host — BMC is responding but locked, IPMI returning "OEM BMC Lock". opening cloud ticket and raising to hardware ops. probable BMC firmware bug after spot preemption. will request soft-reset windows if safe.

lina-custops: notifying ValoraAI on the support channel now. draft message: "We're investigating degraded inference and routing traffic to a reserve pool; you may see increased latency and occasional 5xx while migrations complete. We'll update within 30m." OK to send?

sam-oncall-nyc: send it. include temporary mitigation steps and ETA ~30m.

lina-custops: sent. here is message copy I posted: "ValoraAI team — we've detected a BMC lock on a dedicated GPU node in your reserved pool. We're migrating traffic to a reserved fallback pool and enabling degraded variants to maintain availability. Expected stabilization within 30 minutes. I'll ping again with updates. — Lina, Redwood CS"

alex-sre: what's impact on requests? any error codes or traces?

sam-oncall-nyc: logs show connection resets and 502/503 from the runtime limiter during migration windows. small percentage of requests (approx 4%) returned 5xx, many retried by client successfully. snippet: 

```
[2026-03-15T14:02:19Z] runtime: session_id=abc123 route=valora-prod dest=gpu-06 err=connection_reset
[2026-03-15T14:03:07Z] routing: migrate session_id=abc123 -> reserve-dedicated-1 status=ok
[2026-03-15T14:04:00Z] runtime: request_id=xyz987 status=502 upstream=gpu-06
```

jin-eng-runtime: thanks. I'll watch the stream for KV cache thrash and backpressure. if we see more than 10% transient 5xx we should enable instant-fallback to hosted nodes for critical tenants.

maya-infra: hardware ops created ticket #HOP-8421 with provider; they want a BMC soft reset. asking if soft-reset can proceed without a full host reboot?

sam-oncall-nyc: avoid host reboot until migrations complete. prefer BMC soft-reset. jin — any risk to KV state if BMC reset happens while node is drained?

jin-eng-runtime: node is already out of routing after drain; soft-reset should be safe. KV shards persisted to remote checkpointing; we should be fine. proceed.

deploy-bot: notice: rolling patch 1.2.3 scheduled to prod at 14:30, no overlap with current migrate window.

alex-sre: tagging runbooks — running through dedicated-pool-drain checklist. next steps: 1) confirm migrations complete, 2) verify no active sessions on gpu-06, 3) set node state=quarantine, 4) request hardware replace if BMC soft-reset fails.

sam-oncall-nyc: migration progress: 12/12 tenants migrated, live sessions drained to 0, queued drained. verifying healthchecks...

```
$ redwood ctl node status gpu-06
state: draining -> quarantined
active_sessions: 0
last_health: 2026-03-15T14:10:02Z ok=false bmc_status=locked
```

sam-oncall-nyc: node marked quarantined. removing from rotation.

maya-infra: performed BMC soft-reset at 14:12. BMC responded briefly then went back to locked state. escalating to hardware replace. provider ETA 3-6 hours for swap. opening RMA.

lina-custops: updated ValoraAI: "Node quarantined, migrations complete, BMC soft-reset attempted — hardware replacement in progress (ETA 3-6h). We have reserve capacity handling traffic; performance should be near-normal but expect slight latency increase." Valora replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted. We'll enable client-side retries."

jin-eng-runtime: enabling additional throttling protections and adaptive batching for valora-prod to reduce latency spikes while reserve pool handles extra load.

alex-sre: monitoring SLOs: token latency p50->p95 increased ~40ms, errors down to ~0.5%. acceptable for now but keep watch. create post-incident note with timeline and root-cause suspicion: BMC firmware + spot eviction sequence.

sam-oncall-nyc: handoff in 30m to priya-oncall-eu. priya — I'll leave notes: node gpu-06 quarantined, RMA open HOP-8421, reserve-dedicated-1 handling valora-prod, monitoring SLOs.

priya-oncall-eu: acked. will take over at 14:45 and monitor until RMA completes. I'll coordinate with maya for replacement window.

lina-custops: scheduling follow-up call with Valora ops at +45m to review impact and next steps.

incident-bot: incident severity remains high -> on-call handoff scheduled. incident timeline ticket created: INC-3204506789.

sam-oncall-nyc: closing live thread — leaving it open for handoff notes. great work team, thanks. :white_check_mark:
